title: Q-CONSTITUTION-DRAIN: map the remaining standing rules to a detector and a remediation
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** seed/doctrine/constitution-baseline.json lists standing rules with no constitution entry
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation constitution --check
**Status:** closed

CONSTITUTION-1: each id in the baseline moves into a rule's `covers` (or becomes a rule of its own) in seed/doctrine/constitution.json with code that exists in the seed, then leaves the baseline. The baseline only shrinks; the check fails a baseline entry the constitution already covers.

**Prediction:** constitution_unmapped_rules <= 5 within 336 h
**Out of scope:** adding new standing rules; rewriting the rules' text.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -c "import json;print(len(json.load(open('seed/doctrine/constitution-baseline.json'))['unmapped']))"` prints 0.


**Vacuous:** 2026-11-25T22:32:26Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists

**Disposition:** fixed (executor-failed, 2026-11-26T01:54:55Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 3 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: RuntimeError: every code agent rung failed: workers-ai-glm: HTTPError: HTTP Error 401: Unauthorized | github-models-gpt: RuntimeError: non-JSON re.
